title: Verify a signed document
sub: Check that a PDF is exactly the document that was signed. Your file never leaves your device.
notFound: We couldn't find a completed document for this code.
checkDesc: Choose the PDF you received. We compute its SHA-256 in your browser and compare it with the recorded value.
match: Match — this file is identical to the signed document.
mismatch: No match — this file is different from the signed document.
note: This page shows evidence recorded by Bilit.event E-Sign. It does not by itself establish legal validity, which depends on the law that applies to the agreement.
